groups.title: Agent 工具
groups.lede: 从「让 AI 写代码」到「让它看得见、守得住」。
groups.ledeEn: From "let AI write code" to "let it see and stay safe".
groups.assetAlt: 一次 401 的修复过程：Agent Eyes 收集脱敏证据，agent 按证据定位到本地 cookie 过期，自修复后用同一请求复验为 200。
groups.assetAltEn: A 401 being fixed: Agent Eyes collects redacted evidence, the agent traces it to an expired local cookie, self-repairs it and re-verifies the same request returns 200.

groups.title: Bloom：把视觉判断做成可检验的设计系统
groups.titleEn: Bloom: a design system where visual judgment can be tested
groups.lede: 不是只把颜色做得好看——每套配色都有两条轨，让设计选择能被自动检查。
groups.ledeEn: Not just pretty colors: every palette runs on two rails, so design choices can be checked automatically.
groups.assetAlt: Bloom 六个莫兰迪原色直接当文字时对比度只有 2.3 到 3.3:1；保持色相与彩度，只解亮度到 4.5:1。
groups.assetAltEn: Six Bloom Morandi colors used directly as text only reach 2.3 to 3.3:1 contrast; keeping hue and chroma and solving only lightness brings each to 4.5:1.

skills.title: Skills：给 Agent 装上的表达规范
skills.lede: 写文档、提单、发帖之前先想「这话怎么说才对」的规范集合，一行命令接入 Claude Code / Codex / DSH / Antigravity。
skills.ledeEn: Standards for thinking "how should this be said" before writing docs, tickets or posts. One command to install into Claude Code / Codex / DSH / Antigravity.

vite-plugin-agent-eyes.name: Agent Eyes
vite-plugin-agent-eyes.zh: 给 coding agent 的 Vite 运行时遥测层。把 API 错误、浏览器状态与代理信息整理成 agent 可读的证据，让它自己定位、自己验证。
vite-plugin-agent-eyes.en: A Vite runtime telemetry layer for coding agents. It turns API errors, browser state and proxy details into evidence an agent can read, so it can locate and verify a fix on its own.

kyvault.name: Kyvault
kyvault.zh: 为 AI 工作流设计的本地密钥库：加密保存在本机，工具通过别名取用，agent 不接触密钥明文。
kyvault.en: A local secret vault built for AI workflows: encrypted on your machine, tools fetch secrets by alias, and the agent never handles the plaintext.

dsh-env-inspector.name: DSH Env Inspector
dsh-env-inspector.zh: 检查开发环境、CLI、插件与端口状态；在不暴露密钥明文的前提下，让环境问题可见、可处理。
dsh-env-inspector.en: Checks your dev environment, CLIs, plugins and ports, making environment problems visible and fixable without exposing secret values.

vite-plugin-refresh-guard.name: Vite Refresh Guard
vite-plugin-refresh-guard.zh: 解决网页部署更新后用户仍停留在旧版本的问题。静默刷新、提示后刷新或阻断等待，一行配置选择策略，核心逻辑兼容 Vue 与 React。
vite-plugin-refresh-guard.en: Stops users from staying on a stale build after you deploy. Pick silent reload, prompted reload or a blocking wait in one line of config; the core works with Vue and React.

typora-Bloom-theme.name: Bloom for Typora
typora-Bloom-theme.zh: 24 套主题，为长文写作和沉浸阅读设计；获 Typora 官方主题库收录。
typora-Bloom-theme.en: 24 themes for long-form writing and immersive reading; included in the official Typora theme gallery.

dsh-bloom-theme.name: Bloom for DSH
dsh-bloom-theme.zh: 把同一套莫兰迪视觉语言带进 DeepSeek Harness，提供明暗主题与 OKLCH 配色。
dsh-bloom-theme.en: The same Morandi visual language brought to DeepSeek Harness, with light and dark themes and OKLCH palettes.

contrast-guard.name: contrast-guard
contrast-guard.zh: 在 CI 检查色彩对比度，支持 OKLCH；失败时给出可执行的调色方向。
contrast-guard.en: Checks color contrast in CI with OKLCH support; when a pair fails, it tells you which way to adjust.

scorecard.name: Scorecard
scorecard.zh: 对 GitHub 仓库、npm 包和网站做公开质量检查，生成证据、雷达图与整改建议。
scorecard.en: Public quality checks for GitHub repos, npm packages and websites, with evidence, a radar chart and a fix list.

voxflow.name: VoxFlow
voxflow.zh: Apple Silicon 本地 AI 音频工作台，覆盖中文语音、音色设计、播客与 BGM；私密音频留在本机。
voxflow.en: A local AI audio workbench for Apple Silicon covering Chinese speech, voice design, podcasts and BGM; private audio stays on your machine.

dsh-llm-hub.name: dsh-llm-hub
dsh-llm-hub.zh: 为 DSH 补上模型网关探测、目录发现与余额信息。
dsh-llm-hub.en: Adds model gateway probing, catalog discovery and balance info to DSH.

reel-kit.name: reel-kit
reel-kit.zh: 用素材、逐句文案、配音和模板在本地合成竖版短视频。
reel-kit.en: Composes vertical short videos locally from footage, line-by-line scripts, voiceover and templates.

chat-mood-gen.name: chat-mood-gen
chat-mood-gen.zh: 仿微信与小红书的聊天氛围图生成器：对话 / 拉人 / 列表 / 朋友圈 / 小红书五模式。
chat-mood-gen.en: A generator for WeChat- and Xiaohongshu-style chat mood screenshots: chat, group, feed, moments and post modes.

museav-cli.name: museav-cli
museav-cli.zh: MUSE AV 图像与视频生成 CLI：支持模板、素材上传及本地图像处理，供人和 Agent 从终端调用。
museav-cli.en: MUSE AV CLI for image and video generation, reusable templates, asset uploads and local image tools.

writing-standard-skills.name: writing-standard-skills
writing-standard-skills.zh: 6 个表达 skill + 5D 原子矩阵：搭骨架 → 定读者 → 调语气 → 当读者通读自检。
writing-standard-skills.en: 6 writing skills plus a 5D atomic matrix: build the skeleton, pick the reader, tune the tone, then reread as the reader.

deadcode-reaper-skill.name: deadcode-reaper-skill
deadcode-reaper-skill.zh: 让死代码与废弃 skill 真正入土为安，晒出减法战绩。
deadcode-reaper-skill.en: Retires dead code and stale skills for good, and shows off the subtraction.

charmoji-sticker-skill.name: charmoji-sticker-skill
charmoji-sticker-skill.zh: 一张 IP 正面照 → 整套可提交的微信表情素材，全流程脚本化。
charmoji-sticker-skill.en: One front-facing character portrait becomes a complete, submittable WeChat sticker set, fully scripted.

projects.zh: 框架无关的 AI 流式对话工具包，带 React / Vue 绑定。
projects.en: A framework-agnostic toolkit for streaming AI chat, with React / Vue bindings.

projects.zh: 一份 Markdown 生成演讲页、PDF 与长图。
projects.en: One Markdown file becomes slides, a PDF and a long image.

projects.zh: 4KB 零依赖 SVG，表达 AI 助手当前状态。
projects.en: A 4KB zero-dependency SVG that shows what an AI assistant is doing.

projects.zh: Apple Silicon 本地离线图片理解。
projects.en: Local, offline image understanding on Apple Silicon.

projects.zh: 飞书 / 企业微信通知库，带重试与去重。
projects.en: A Lark / WeCom notification library with retries and deduplication.

projects.zh: PATH 命令诊断 CLI：定位实际执行的副本与版本漂移。
projects.en: PATH diagnostics CLI: find the copy that actually runs and detect version drift.

projects.zh: CLI 工具目录与发现站，按用途与 Stars 快照排名。
projects.en: A CLI directory and discovery site ranked by purpose and a Stars snapshot.

projects.zh: 一个安静的 macOS Git 客户端。Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + git2。
projects.en: A calm macOS Git client. Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + git2.

projects.zh: 浏览器壁纸编辑器：多设备预设、水印与导出 PNG。
projects.en: A browser wallpaper editor: device presets, watermarks and PNG export.

projects.zh: 中文 AI 编程助手入门教程，含 AGENTS.md 协作指南。
projects.en: A Chinese beginner guide to coding agents, requirements and Git workflows.

projects.zh: 把个人开源工具链接进 AI Agent 的 MCP 服务，按能力分组。
projects.en: An MCP server that strings a personal open-source toolchain into AI agents, per capability group.

projects.zh: AI Agent 浏览器自动化 CLI：CDP 操控、会话复用与人工接管。
projects.en: Browser automation CLI for AI agents with CDP, reusable sessions and human handoffs.

projects.zh: 确定性的浏览器 / 设备画像，用于自动化与测试。
projects.en: Deterministic, self-consistent browser/device personas for automation and testing.

projects.zh: 图床素材仓库：个人项目的图片经 GitHub raw 与 jsDelivr 分发。
projects.en: Image assets for personal projects, served over GitHub raw and jsDelivr.

projects.zh: DSH 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看出图记录与素材直链。
projects.en: A DSH plugin that browses generated assets and image libraries by workspace.

projects.zh: 发版时自动把版本号同步到台账与 SKILL.md。
projects.en: Syncs release versions into the ledger and SKILL.md at publish time.

projects.zh: 音乐发行管理工作台：上架台账与填表辅助。
projects.en: A music release management dashboard: release ledger and form-filling help.

projects.zh: Claude Code 状态栏：会话花费与额度预警。
projects.en: A Claude Code status line: session cost and quota warnings.
